title: nav-graph.json field contract
description: Field contract for data/nav-graph.json — the pre-generated navigation graph consumed by Zola templates (worker N). Each route node describes where you can go from that page.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking change.

generated_at.description: ISO8601 generation timestamp. Does not affect route content; idempotency is defined over the routes structure only.

content_root.description: Content root directory (relative to repo root).

route_folding.description: How file paths map to Zola routes. The single source of truth for route computation.

leaf.description: Leaf page: route is one level deeper than the file directory.

index.description: Index page: route folds into the containing directory.

counts.description: Summary counts for evidence and sanity checks.

routes.description: Map of route → navigation node. Keys are sorted lexicographically.

unclassifiable.description: Files under content/ that could not be assigned a route (e.g. .txt).

routeNode.description: Navigation node for a single route.

route.description: This page's Zola route (with trailing slash).

path.description: File path relative to repo root.

title.description: Page title (frontmatter title, fallback to filename).

parentRoute.description: Parent route in the tree. null only for the root page /.

prevRoute.description: Previous sibling route (sorted by weight, title, route). null if first sibling.

nextRoute.description: Next sibling route. Null if last sibling.

upChain.description: Chain of parent routes from this page's parent up to root (excludes this page).

crossLanguageRoutes.description: Routes of the same page in other languages (same version, same path suffix). Empty for L0/L1 pages.

crossVersionRoutes.description: Routes of the same page in other versions (same language, same path suffix). Empty for L0/L1 pages.

relatedRoutes.description: Related entry routes from navigation.json children. Empty if not in navigation.json.
